extDesc.message: Passive DOM sensor for Gamblock AI. Reads page content and forwards it to the local AI classifier via an authenticated WebSocket. This extension never classifies content or blocks pages itself.

optionsDesc1.message: Enter the pairing token shown by the Gamblock AI client application. This token authenticates the extension to the local Windows Service via WebSocket.

optionsDesc2.message: The token is stored locally in chrome.storage.local and is never sent to any server other than the local service at ws://127.0.0.1:9090.

statusSavedActive.message: Token saved. Connection active in background.
